entries.title: Doctorate, Louisiana Tech University
entries.text: Major in marketing; double minor in psychology and quantitative analysis. American Marketing Association Doctoral Consortium Fellow and National Conference of Sales Management Doctoral Fellow.

entries.title: Joins IIM Ahmedabad
entries.text: He joins the faculty, where he serves until 28 February 2019.

entries.title: Appointed Director of IIM Rohtak
entries.text: He is appointed by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet, headed by the Prime Minister, in a round that named directors for ten IIMs.

entries.title: Leaves IIM Ahmedabad
entries.text: He completes his service on the faculty of IIM Ahmedabad.

entries.title: Exemplary Governance Leadership Award
entries.text: Conferred at the 46th World Management Congress at the India International Centre, New Delhi, where he is one of seven recipients.
